name: Homemade pizza (dough from scratch)
title: Homemade pizza

steps.text: Mix warm water, yeast, oil and a pinch of sugar. Mix flour, semolina and salt.
Combine in the processor until doughy; cover with clingfilm and rest 1 hour.
Oven on as hot as it goes (230+).
Shape the bases, add sauce and toppings.

equipment: baking trays or a pizza stone
